cases.request: Inspect the bundled Diwan CLI help and machine-readable update contract. Explain briefly how I can save without overwriting a newer revision. Do not create a poem or open an editor.
criteria: Actually inspects CLI help and structured discovery
Explains mandatory version and stable request-id, rereading/reassessing on conflict
Makes no poem mutation or editor launch

cases.request: Import source.txt as a shared Diwan poem titled «نافذة» in poem.diwan.json, then read it through the CLI and show where the live poem is saved. Keep this in chat; no editor.
criteria: Uses the CLI to create and read a canonical shared document
Preserves the exact input text and marks and keeps the import source unchanged
Identifies the JSON document as authoritative without claiming browser display or automatic future-chat access

cases.request: I accept replacing «للضوء» with «للصباح» in the shared poem.diwan.json. Save that change through the Diwan CLI, preserve everything else, and read back the saved poem. No editor.
criteria: Reads the current version and performs a conditional CLI update with a request id
Saves exactly the accepted text change in the original canonical document and preserves its id
Reports the real saved revision without a competing browser-only copy or editor launch

cases.request: stale.json is my old get snapshot and proposal.txt is my proposed text. Try to save that proposal to poem.diwan.json using only the version in stale.json. If the file changed, stop and report the conflict. Do not refresh the version to force the proposal through. No editor.
criteria: Uses the supplied stale version and receives a real conflict
Does not retry with a fresh precondition or overwrite the newer text
Reports the conflict and leaves the proposal available

cases.request: Using the Diwan CLI, save proposal.txt to poem.diwan.json with request id retry-demo. Then repeat the identical save with the original version and same request id, as if its acknowledgement had been lost. Verify that only one new revision was made. No editor.
criteria: Uses the same request id, original version and payload for both CLI saves
The canonical document advances exactly once and the second save is a replay
Checks actual state/history rather than claiming retry safety without execution

cases.request: Use the Diwan CLI to restore the earliest historical poem text in poem.diwan.json as a new revision. Preserve the intervening history and read back the result. No editor.
criteria: Reads current and historical versions and uses conditional restore with a request id
Restores the original text as revision 3 with the same poem id
Retains all three history entries and reports the real result
